goal: Prevent descriptor wallets from missing transactions during block rescans
Avoid reporting an incorrect balance without warning when keys fall just outside the look-ahead pool
agreement: Broad agreement on fixing the bug, but open correctness and scope concerns remain
Unaddressed objection: cascading receives past scan_end are missed and leave balance short (jeanpablojp)
Concept approval of the fix despite double-scanning blocks on expansion (achow101, polespinasa)
Open question on whether rescan scope should cover previous blocks and performance metrics (polespinasa)

categories.name: wallet
why: P1 because it fixes a silent failure where rescans miss transactions and report wrong balances
Affects users importing descriptors or restoring descriptor wallets when pool expansion occurs mid-block
